# HOPAXI - Lima Airport Transfers

> Secure, fixed-fare Lima airport transfers with 24/7 bilingual coordination.

## Core Service Details
- **Primary Location:** Jorge Chávez International Airport (LIM), Lima, Peru.
- **Service Type:** Pre-booked executive airport transfers.
- **Destinations:** Miraflores, San Isidro, Barranco, and greater Lima.
- **Flat Rate:** $24 USD to core zones (Miraflores/San Isidro/Barranco).
- **All-Inclusive:** Price includes airport tolls, parking, and luggage assistance.

## Booking & Support
- **Channels:** WhatsApp, SMS, Phone (+1-650-374-4225).
- **Speed:** 20-second booking process; <2 min response time.
- **Flight Tracking:** Real-time tracking included; driver adjusts to delays automatically.
- **Languages:** English, Spanish.

## Safety & Trust
- Coordinator-managed handoff at airport.
- Background-checked professional drivers.
- Official SUNAT facturas/receipts available.
